facts.fact: The World Bank PID says the National ICT Development Strategy (Plan Tchad Numérique 2017-2021) was adopted in November 2017.
The PID gives the National ICT Development Strategy (Plan Tchad Numérique) a period of 2017-2021.

The PID says the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Economy elaborated the Strategic Plan for the Development of Digital and Post 2021-2030, 'currently in force' (no date given, so the document's published date is used).
